query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Clean up and enrich HubSpot CRM records by listing contacts and companies, matching contacts to companies, assigning segmentation values from job title and company industry, creating required CRM properties, updating contacts in bulk, creating associations, and attempting a later bulk import of companies and contacts.
query_ground_truth.query: create custom CRM properties in HubSpot
query_ground_truth.intent: Set up the required custom property fields in HubSpot to store the new segmentation values.

results.use_case: create custom CRM properties in HubSpot
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if permissions are unclear or writes fail)] [Prerequisite]: Check available OAuth scopes using HUBSPOT_LIST_GRANTED_SCOPES (confirm schema/property write access).
[Optional (if object type already exists)] [Prerequisite]: Locate the target custom object type using HUBSPOT_RETRIEVE_ALL_OBJECT_SCHEMAS (avoid duplicate creation).
[Required] [Step]: Create the custom object type using HUBSPOT_CREATE_OBJECT_SCHEMA (define labels and primary identifiers); if it already exists, adjust settings using HUBSPOT_UPDATE_OBJECT_SCHEMA.
[Optional (if properties should be organized or groupName is unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Discover existing property groups using HUBSPOT_READ_PROPERTY_GROUPS_FOR_OBJECT_TYPE.
[Optional (if a new group is needed)] [Prerequisite]: Create a property group using HUBSPOT_CREATE_AND_RETURN_A_NEW_PROPERTY_GROUP (prepare a valid groupName for properties).
[Required] [Step]: Create properties in bulk using HUBSPOT_CREATE_BATCH_OF_PROPERTIES (define field types and assign groupName), then validate using HUBSPOT_READ_ALL_PROPERTIES_FOR_OBJECT_TYPE.
known_pitfalls: [HUBSPOT_CREATE_OBJECT_SCHEMA] Creating a duplicate or invalid object definition can fail with validation errors; ensure the custom object type is unique before creating.
[HUBSPOT_UPDATE_OBJECT_SCHEMA] Some schema attributes may be immutable after creation; attempts to change restricted fields can be rejected.
[HUBSPOT_CREATE_BATCH_OF_PROPERTIES] A single invalid property definition (bad type, bad groupName, duplicate internal name) can cause the whole batch request to fail.
[HUBSPOT_CREATE_PROPERTY_FOR_SPECIFIED_OBJECT_TYPE] Incorrect objectType or groupName commonly results in not-found or validation failures; use when batch creation is blocked for a specific field.

HUBSPOT_CREATE_OBJECT_SCHEMA.description: Creates a new custom object schema in HubSpot CRM with unique naming for schema and properties, defined display/required/searchable properties within the 'properties' list, provided immutable labels, and correctly configured 'enumeration' type properties (options/referencedObjectType).

name.description: Unique, immutable programmatic name for the schema (used in API calls); must be unique in the account.
Unique internal programmatic name for API use.

hidden.description: Hides the property in the HubSpot UI if true.

value.description: Internal value used when setting the property via API.

hidden.description: Hides the option in the HubSpot UI if true.

description.description: Optional help text for the option.

displayOrder.description: Sort order for display; -1 places it after positive values.

items.description: Defines an option for an enumeration property.

options.description: List of options for 'enumeration' type properties; required for this type.

fieldType.description: UI field type (e.g., 'text', 'select'); depends on property 'type'.

formField.description: Allows this property to be used in HubSpot forms if true.

groupName.description: Property group name for UI organization.

description.description: Optional help text for the property displayed in HubSpot.

displayOrder.description: Display order relative to other properties; -1 places it after positive values.

hasUniqueValue.description: Ensures property value is unique across all records; immutable after creation.

textDisplayHint.description: Display and validation hint for 'string' type properties in UI.

numberDisplayHint.description: Display hint for 'number' type properties in UI.

optionSortStrategy.description: Sort strategy for 'enumeration' property options in UI: 'DISPLAY_ORDER' or 'ALPHABETICAL'.

showCurrencySymbol.description: Displays currency symbol for 'number' type properties with 'CURRENCY' or 'FORMATTED' hint.

referencedObjectType.description: For 'enumeration' type, specifies the object type whose records populate options (e.g., 'CONTACT', 'COMPANY', 'OWNER' for users).

searchableInGlobalSearch.description: Makes property values searchable in HubSpot's global search; subject to limits.

items.description: Defines a property for a custom object schema.

properties.description: List of property definitions for this custom object schema.

description.description: Optional human-readable description for the custom object schema.

labels__plural.description: Plural display name used in HubSpot UI; immutable after creation.

labels__singular.description: Singular display name used in HubSpot UI; immutable after creation.

associatedObjects.description: Object type IDs (e.g., 'CONTACT', 'COMPANY', 'p123456') this schema can be associated with.

requiredProperties.description: Internal names of properties required for new records; must be defined in 'properties'.

searchableProperties.description: Internal names of properties indexed for global search; must be defined in 'properties'.

primaryDisplayProperty.description: Internal name of the primary identifier property; must be defined in 'properties'.

secondaryDisplayProperties.description: Internal names of properties for secondary display on record pages; must be defined in 'properties'.

HUBSPOT_UPDATE_OBJECT_SCHEMA.description: Updates an existing custom object schema's metadata in HubSpot, such as its description, labels, display properties, required properties, searchable properties, and restorability, for a specified `objectType` that must already exist.

objectType.description: The fully qualified name or object type ID that uniquely identifies the custom object schema to be updated. This must correspond to an existing schema in your HubSpot account.

restorable.description: A boolean indicating whether records of this object type can be restored from the recycle bin if deleted. Set to `true` to enable restoration, `false` otherwise.

examples: Defines the structure for customer support tickets.
description.description: A human-readable description for the custom object schema itself.

labels__plural.description: The plural display name for the custom object type (e.g., 'Companies', 'Tickets'), used in the HubSpot UI for multiple records of this type.

labels__singular.description: The singular display name for the custom object type (e.g., 'Company', 'Ticket'), used in the HubSpot UI for a single record of this type.

requiredProperties.description: A list of internal names of properties that are mandatory when creating a new record of this object type.

searchableProperties.description: A list of internal names of properties that will be indexed and searchable within HubSpot's product search for this object type.

primaryDisplayProperty.description: The internal name of the property that will serve as the primary display identifier on the HubSpot record page for this object type. This is typically a unique identifier like a name or ID.

secondaryDisplayProperties.description: A list of internal names of properties to be displayed as secondary information on the HubSpot record page for this object type. These properties appear below the primary display property.

HUBSPOT_RETRIEVE_ALL_OBJECT_SCHEMAS.description: Retrieves all object schema definitions (not data records) for a HubSpot account, supporting retrieval of either active or archived schemas.

archived.description: Set to true to retrieve only archived object schemas, or false for only active, non-archived schemas. Archived schemas are typically inactive but retained for historical/compliance.

HUBSPOT_CREATE_BATCH_OF_PROPERTIES.description: Efficiently creates multiple CRM properties in a single batch for a specified HubSpot object type (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies', custom object ID), ideal for schema setup or updates.

name.description: Internal programmatic name, unique for the object type. Must contain only lowercase letters (a-z), numbers (0-9), and underscores (_). Must start with a letter. No spaces, hyphens, or special characters allowed.

type.description: Specifies the kind of data this property stores.

hidden.description: If true, property is hidden and inaccessible in HubSpot UI.
If true, hides the option in the HubSpot UI.

description.description: Optional descriptive context for the option.

displayOrder.description: Sort order for display in UI (ascending; -1 for last).

items.description: Defines a single option for an enumeration property.

options.description: Defines pre-set options for an 'enumeration' type property; required if `type` is 'enumeration' and `externalOptions` is false. For boolean properties (type='bool'), if not provided, options are auto-generated with values 'true' and 'false'.

fieldType.description: Controls UI rendering, behavior, and input field type for the property.

formField.description: If true, property can be used in HubSpot forms.

groupName.description: Property group name for UI organization.

description.description: User-friendly description/help text displayed in HubSpot UI.

displayOrder.description: Display order within its group in UI (ascending; -1 for last).

hasUniqueValue.description: If true, property value must be unique across all object records; unchangeable once set.

externalOptions.description: For 'enumeration' type properties, if true, options are sourced externally (e.g., from HubSpot users if `referencedObjectType` is 'OWNER').

calculationFormula.description: HubSpot-specific formula if `fieldType` is 'calculation_equation', to compute the property's value.

referencedObjectType.description: For "enumeration" type with `externalOptions` true, set to "OWNER" to source options from HubSpot users.

items.description: Definition of a CRM property to be created.

inputs.description: List of definitions for the new properties to be created.

objectType.description: Target HubSpot CRM object type (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies', 'deals', or custom object ID) for property creation.

HUBSPOT_RETRIEVE_OBJECT_SCHEMA.description: Fetches the detailed schema definition for a specified, existing standard or custom HubSpot CRM object type; this action is read-only and does not create or modify schemas.

objectType.description: Fully qualified name for standard HubSpot objects (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies') or unique object type ID for custom objects (e.g., 'p123456', '2-xxxxxxx'). Case-sensitive and must match an existing object type as defined in HubSpot.
